claims.claim: Reid Wiseman joins Caltech and NASA JPL as associate vice president and deputy director on November 30, 2026.
claims.episode_span: Former astronaut and Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman joins Caltech as associate vice president and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory as deputy director on November 30.
claims.source_title: Caltech Names Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman as NASA JPL Deputy
claims.supporting_quote: Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman has been named Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. The emeritus astronaut and retired U.S. Navy captain begins his new role at NASA’s center of excellence for robotics and deep space exploration and at Caltech, which manages JPL for NASA, on Nov. 30, 2026.

claims.claim: During Artemis II, Wiseman and crew traveled 695,081 miles on a lunar flyby.
claims.episode_span: During Artemis II he traveled 695,081 miles on a lunar flyby farther than any humans before.
claims.supporting_quote: journeyed 695,081 miles on a lunar flyby that took them farther than any humans have ever traveled before.

claims.claim: Virgin Galactic’s first Delta-class space plane, named Apeiron, was flown from Mesa to Spaceport America on October 28.
claims.episode_span: The new vehicle, named Apeiron after a worldwide public vote, flew from its Mesa factory to Spaceport America on October 28.
claims.source_title: Virgin Galactic Flies Next-Gen Space Plane to New Home With New Name
claims.supporting_quote: More than two decades after SpaceShipOne won a $10 million X Prize for private spaceflight, Virgin Galactic ferried its third-generation rocket ship from its factory in Mesa, Ariz., to its home base at Spaceport America in New Mexico on Oct. 28.

claims.claim: NASA’s UVEX ultraviolet telescope is planned to launch in 2031 and will be about 100 times more powerful than GALEX.
claims.episode_span: The UltraViolet EXplorer will deliver roughly 100 times the sensitivity of the earlier GALEX mission that ended in 2013.
claims.source_title: NASA's New UV Space Telescope Will Launch in 2031
claims.supporting_quote: NASA has committed to launching a new, more powerful UV space telescope. Named UVEX, the UltraViolet EXplorer, it will launch in 2031. It's about 100 times more powerful than its predecessor, GALEX, whose mission ended in 2013.

claims.claim: New observations show the red supergiant’s orbiting companion creates an egg-like distortion in the star’s outer layers.
claims.episode_span: New observations show the red supergiant’s orbiting companion creates an egg-like distortion in the star’s outer layers.
claims.supporting_quote: Betelgeuse has a close-orbiting companion that disturbs the red supergiant into an egg-like shape.

claims.claim: Simulations indicate that shock waves generated in the outer atmospheres of giant planets can remove orbital energy and drive them inward to tight orbits around their stars.
claims.episode_span: Simulations indicate that shock waves generated in the outer atmospheres of giant planets can remove orbital energy and drive them inward to tight orbits around their stars.
claims.supporting_quote: migrate from distant, elliptical orbits as they release energy via dramatic shock waves in their outer atmospheres

claims.claim: Technicians completed the short-stack configuration of the Artemis III SLS rocket inside the Vehicle Assembly Building at Kennedy Space Center on October 28.
claims.episode_span: Technicians completed the short-stack configuration of the Artemis III SLS rocket inside the Vehicle Assembly Building at Kennedy Space Center on October 28.
claims.supporting_quote: integrated alongside the twin solid rocket boosters on Oct. 28 inside the Vehicle Assembly Building’s High Bay 3

claims.claim: Researchers produced the first global estimates of the solar magnetic field beyond the visible surface, improving models of space-weather drivers.
claims.episode_span: Researchers produced the first global estimates of the solar magnetic field beyond the visible surface, improving models of space-weather drivers.
claims.supporting_quote: first global, three-dimensional estimates of the sun's magnetic field, including the area beyond the sun's visible edge
